admission.justification: Inferring the wrong owner can close another leaf history or turn unavailable public recovery into a false success claim.

applicability: Direct leaf history-owner selection and public recovery of an admitted interrupted canonical-leaf-bound doorless direct generation.
conditions: An explicit valid leaf_id selects and closes that history, including rowless history.
A proven bound_leaf_id selects the admitted leaf before optional caller leaf_id; only absence of both selectors takes the legacy sole-open-owner inference.
Public recover pins the expected accepted generation, continues its existing effective input and settles its kept closing receipt on completion.
exclusions: Public lifecycle-control recovery is refused for legacy direct generations lacking both compatible TaskIntent and an admitted canonical leaf input. Current canonical-leaf-bound generations retain their advertised controls; the retained historical public-refusal proof has legacy scope, not current-bound public-route success.
Ordinary closeout records without task intent retain their separate refusal treatment.
Earlier-shape direct records carrying a closeout door publication offer no controls.
Retirement does not reopen a converted history already closed for the same leaf.
statement: direct_landing takes leaf_id (judges/closes the named leaf, refuses another leaf's open file, names leaf_id when none-or-several are open); public recovery continues its accepted interrupted canonical-leaf-bound doorless generation and settles the kept closing receipt in the same call.
